stories.title: 6 terrorists killed, 2 soldiers martyred during Dera Ismail Khan IBO: ISPR
stories.brief: Fitna al Khawarij is a term the state uses for terrorists belonging to the banned Tehreek-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP). “Owing to [the] meticulous conduct of operation by security forces, six India-sponsored khawarij were sent to hell,” ISPR said.

stories.title: Security forces kill terrorist commander in Qila Saifullah operation: state media
stories.brief: Security forces killed a terrorist commander of Fitna Al-Khawarij, Adil Shah, alias Darvesh, during an intelligence-based operation (IBO) in Qila Saifullah, Balochistan, under Operation Radd-ul-Fitna 3, Radio Pakistan reported, citing security sources.

stories.title: Rosebank: Life on the oil field at the centre of a political storm
stories.brief: Scotland editor James Cook finds out what life is like on board a ship in an untapped oil field awaiting its fate.

stories.title: Carrick future under major threat - can he survive?
stories.brief: Michael Carrick's future as Manchester United manager is under major threat following the home loss to Bournemouth on Sunday.

stories.title: Fernandes left on bench for Man Utd defeat - a failed gamble?
stories.brief: Manchester United skipper Bruno Fernandes is left on the bench for Sunday's 3-0 loss to Bournemouth, following his criticism of manager Michael Carrick.

stories.title: ECP proposes 12 amendments to regulate AI, curb misuse in elections
stories.brief: The Election Commission of Pakistan (ECP) proposed 12 amendments to the 2023 codes of conduct for political parties, media organisations and election observers to curb the misuse of artificial intelligence (AI) during elections.

stories.title: Protesters clash with police over India dam project bordering China
stories.brief: Indian protesters angry over a proposed Himalayan mega-dam, intended to counter an upstream Chinese hydropower project, have clashed with police and torched buildings, officials said. India says the proposed dam is needed to counter China’s $167-billion Yaxia project, a likely record-breaking hydropower scheme upstream in Tibet.

stories.title: PM kicks off distribution of 500,000 Chromebooks, internet devices to students
stories.brief: Addressing a ceremony under the Prime Minister’s Youth Programme, the prime minister said, “Intelligence and hard work should not be held captive by wealth and poverty," stressing that merit and effort should determine which students received the devices.

stories.title: FM Dar, Chinese envoy discuss CPEC, trade and regional stability
stories.brief: Jiang Zaidong, called on Deputy Prime Minister/Foreign Minister Senator Mohammad Ishaq Dar @MIshaqDar50. Read: Pakistan, China agree to align development plans, launch CPEC 2.0 Pakistan and China marked the 75th anniversary of their diplomatic relations this year, with both sides seeking to expand cooperation beyond traditional infrastructure projects.

stories.title: Israeli air strike on Gaza City university kills three people
stories.brief: Two Israeli strikes hit students and security guards at the Islamic University in Gaza City.

stories.title: Seven killed in Gaza as Israel targets university campus and other sites
stories.brief: Israeli air strike kills three security guards in one of two attacks on the Islamic University in Gaza City.

stories.title: Volkswagen to build $4bn Audi SUV factory in US despite job cuts at home
stories.brief: VW investment, creating 4,500 jobs in Georgia, comes amid Trump’s damaging tariffs, intense Chinese competition and costly shift towards EVsAudi has said it will spend $4bn (£3bn) to build its first factory in the US, as its parent company, Volkswagen, struggles with the impact of steep tariffs imposed by Donald Trump.The German brand’s chief executive…

stories.title: Musk says SpaceX restricted Ukraine's Starlink connection as service restored
stories.brief: The tech billionaire accuses Ukraine of violating its terms of service by using the network for military activity.

stories.title: From Russian cages to Irish sanctuary: The five-year rescue journey of Bu and Tyapa
stories.brief: For Bu and Tyapa, the five-year journey from Russia to the Irish countryside was anything but straightforward.

stories.title: Amber weather warning as Storm Boelo hits Scotland
stories.brief: The Met Office has issued an amber warning for wind over Scotland from 21:00 until 21:00 on Sunday.

stories.title: Storm Boelo to bring severe gales and heavy rain into Sunday
stories.brief: An amber weather warning has been issued for much of Scotland, parts of Northern Ireland and northern England, as Storm Boelo approaches.

stories.title: Wales plans to ban steel pylons as government launches consultation
stories.brief: The Welsh government says it is consulting on an "undergrounding-first approach" to electricity lines.

stories.title: Students across country to get 500,000 Chromebooks over 2 years, announces PM Shehbaz
stories.brief: ISLAMABAD: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif on Sunday launched a scheme under which the government would distribute 500,000 Chromebook laptops to students nationwide over two years.

stories.title: New leave policy for Islamabad Police ensures weekly off for all personnel
stories.brief: ISLAMABAD: The capital’s police have introduced a new leave policy to ease difficulties faced by officers and officials in obtaining leave and ensure, for the first time, that all personnel get at least one day of weekly rest, it emerged on Sunday.

stories.title: Australia survive scare to beat Fiji and reach World Cup semi-finals
stories.brief: Defending champions Australia survive a scare to come from behind and beat Fiji 36-22 in their second pool match at the Rugby League World Cup; a victory which secures their place in the semi-finals with one pool match to spare.
